assessments.reasoning: The PDF cover, imprint and copyright page identify Borland's Object Pascal guide. The DigiPen URL hosts the original publisher document. Fresh capture digest eb13b085988e26f25bc281bb0f9e91c2d30cd345291cf6626bbde10621fd2885 binds the full inspected response. The controlling passage is Chapter 2, Overview, Program organization, printed page 2-1 / PDF page 15. Borland's Object Pascal guide describes units as source modules and describes a program heading that may be followed by a uses clause. The statement applies to the program organization described in the Borland guide used with Delphi or Kylix. This guide itself qualifies the usual program organization. It establishes no universal rule for Apple Object Pascal or all Pascal dialects. The guide distinguishes program source from supporting form and other project files.
